description_zh: 获取座席工作量报表数据
name: CloudAgentWorkloadReport

parameters.help_en:
The call center ID.

Before calling this operation, create a call center instance in the Cloud Call Center console and obtain the instance ID from the instance access URL
parameters.help_zh:
呼叫中心 id

调用前需在云联络中心控制台创建呼叫中心实例，并从实例访问地址中获取实例 ID
parameters.name: enterprise_id

parameters.help_en:
The statistical method. Valid values:
0: by hour.
1: by day.
2: summary.
10: queue summary
parameters.help_zh:
统计方法；说明：
0：分时
1：分日
2：汇总
10：队列汇总
parameters.name: statistic_method

parameters.help_en:
The statistical report type. Valid values:
1: Daily report.
2: Weekly report.
3: Monthly report.
4: Custom time range
parameters.help_zh: 说明：统计报表类型，1：日报表2：周报表3：月报表4：自定义时间
parameters.name: time_range_type

parameters.help_en: The start time of the statistical date range. Format: yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.help_zh: 说明：统计日期的开始时间，格式：yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the statistical date range. Format: yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.help_zh: 说明：统计日期的结束时间，格式：yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The agent ID. Queries workload statistics for specified agents by agent ID. You can specify multiple agent IDs separated by commas (,). By default, workload statistics for all agents under the account are queried
parameters.help_zh: 座席号；说明：根据座席工号查询指定座席的工作量统计支持按照多个座席工号进行查询，多个座席工号之间使用英文逗号","分隔，默认查询账户下所有座席的工作量统计
parameters.name: cnos

parameters.help_en: The outbound call ID. Queries workload statistics for specified agents by outbound call ID. By default, workload statistics for all agents under the account are queried
parameters.help_zh: 说明：根据外呼编号查询指定座席的工作量统计,默认查询账户下所有座席的工作量统计
parameters.name: gnos

parameters.help_en: The query start position. The value must be greater than or equal to 0. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 查询起始位置；取值：大于等于0，默认0
parameters.name: start

parameters.help_en: The number of records to query. Maximum value: 1000. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 查询条数；取值：最大不能超过1000，默认10
parameters.name: limit

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of OK indicates that the request was successful. For other error codes, see the error code list
